steps.title: Inspect Build Failures and Logs

steps.description: Correct 'match_height' to 'match_parent' in the root LinearLayout's 'android:layout_width' attribute.

steps.description: Ensure layout IDs for calculator buttons match standard layout bindings.

steps.title: Inspect Kaprekar Magic Layout Elements
steps.description: Validate the text fields, buttons, and scrolls for 6174 Kaprekar operations.

steps.title: Confirm Mind Reader View Components
steps.description: Verify view properties and visibility flags for binary mind-reading card views.

steps.title: Check MainActivity Java Implementations
steps.description: Examine Java class bindings for clean operation without compilation issues.

steps.title: Review App Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Ensure the manifest structure aligns with standard relative package layouts.

steps.title: Confirm Java 8 Compatibility Rules
steps.description: Ensure no incompatible lambda expressions or modern library calls are introduced.

steps.title: Building Magic Math Calculator
steps.description: Compile raw XML files and execute the Gradle assembler command.
